A classic piece of sportswear reimagined in a fabric with centuries of heritage. This half-zip pullover takes its cues from traditional outdoor fleeces, but replaces synthetic pile with a robust 16.2oz Casentino wool, the famed Florentine cloth known for its distinctive bobbly surface.
